cohort: A cohort of 90 women aged 18-38 years, para 0-5, weighing 50-75 kg, ASA class I & II, undergoing elective full-term cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: The efficacy (absence of intraoperative vomiting) was significantly higher in women who received a bolus dose of propofol (93.3%) compared to the placebo group (66.7%).
